verdict.rationale: Termius documents multiple terminal sessions grouped into Workspaces with tabs, layouts and per-tab working directories. Each host gets its own context through environment variables, group defaults and startup snippets, and its own history through per-host session logs and shell-history autocomplete. Nothing in the pack shows per-session appearance such as themes, colors or fonts. Missing for 10: per-session appearance/theme customization, independent hands-on corroboration of multi-session workflows.
